title: FY27 FCI MCKEAN TRASH REMOVING
agency: JUSTICE, DEPARTMENT OF > FEDERAL PRISON SYSTEM / BUREAU OF PRISONS > FCI MCKEAN
description: The Federal Bureau of Prisons, Federal Correctional Institution (FCI) McKean, Bradford, Pennsylvania, herein issues solicitation  15B20927Q00000006  for the requirements of: TRASH REMOVAL SERVICES. This solicitation is restricted, 100% Small Business. Services are expected to begin JANUARY 1, 2027 and run through SEPTEMBER 30th, 2027.  Services will take place at FCI McKean, 6975 Route 59, Lewis Run, PA 16738, 15 Miles South of Bradford, PA.  The contract type is a firm-fixed price. The Government reserves the right upon award to make formal single or multiple awards. The Government will award the responsible offerors whose bid, conforming to the solicitation, are considered to be most advantageous to the Government, with both past performance and price considered. The solicitation will be available on November 20th, 2026 at 2:00 PM EST and will be posted to the General Services Administration Federal Business Opportunities website: www.sam.gov/. All future information about this acquisition, including solicitation amendments, will be distributed through this site. Interested parties are responsible for monitoring this site to ensure they have the most up-to-date information about this solicitation.  All contractors doing business with the Federal Government shall be registered in the System for Award Management (SAM) database.  The website for registration is:  www.sam.gov.  The closing date for receipt of quotes is DECEMBER 18TH, 2026 at 1:00 PM EST. Payment will be made using Electronic Funds Transfer (EFT) through a purchase order.  Faith-based and community-based organizations have the right to submit offers/quotes equally with other organizations for contracts for which they are eligible. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code applicable to this requirement is 562111.  The point of contact for all information regarding this solicitation is Cory Sudbrook, Supervisory Contract Specialist, telephone number (814)-362-8900 extension 3419 and Alyssa McGrew, Contract Specialist, at the address listed below and telephone number (814) 362-8900, extension 3422.  Completed offers must be emailed to amcgrew@bop.gov and csudbrook@bop.gov  or faxed to (814) 363-6815. Emails are preferred. If you do not receive a confirmation email, please call to verify. The anticipated award date is DECEMBER 28th, 2026.
